title: Xi Jinping begins state visit to Moscow
body:
Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in Moscow on Monday, 20 March 2023, for a state visit at the invitation of Russian President Vladimir Putin. The visit was scheduled to run through Wednesday, 22 March. It was Xi's first trip to Russia since the start of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022.

Xi's plane landed at Vnukovo Airport at about 13:00 local time. He was greeted by Russian Deputy Prime Minister Dmitry Chernyshenko and other senior officials, and the arrival ceremony included an honor guard and the national anthems of both countries.

In remarks on arrival, reported by Chinese government media, Xi described China-Russia relations as those of friendly neighbours and said they were not an alliance, not confrontational and not directed at any third party. He said the two sides would work together to uphold the United Nations-centred international system, international law and the UN Charter, and to promote multilateralism, a multipolar world and more equitable global governance. He expressed confidence that the visit would produce fruitful results.

The visit took place three days after the International Criminal Court announced an arrest warrant for Putin on 17 March 2023. Xi was making his first foreign trip after being confirmed for a third term as Chinese president earlier in March.
